answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive list of **Sherlock Holmes Movies**, organized by era:

---

## 🎩 Sherlock Holmes Movies — Complete List

---

### 🎞️ Silent Era (1900s–1920s)
Early films like *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900) and *A Study in Scarlet* (1914) introduced Holmes to cinema.

| Year | Title | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1900 | *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* | Unknown |
| 1905 | *Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom* | |
| 1916 | *Sherlock Holmes* | William Gillette |
| 1922 | *Sherlock Holmes* | John Barrymore |

John Barrymore played the role in the 1922 movie *Sherlock Holmes*, with Roland Young as Watson and William Powell in his first screen appearance.

---

### 🎙️ Early Talkies (1929–1937)
Arthur Wontner's series and films like *The Speckled Band* (1931) brought Holmes to the sound era, blending fidelity to the source material with modernized elements.

| Year | Title | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1929 | *The Return of Sherlock Holmes* | Clive Brook |
| 1931 | *The Speckled Band* | Raymond Massey |
| 1931 | *The Sleeping Cardinal* | Arthur Wontner |
| 1932 | *Sherlock Holmes* | Clive Brook |
| 1933 | *A Study in Scarlet* | Reginald Owen |
| 1937 | *Silver Blaze* | Arthur Wontner |

Clive Brook played Sherlock Holmes three times: *The Return of Sherlock Holmes* (1929), *Paramount on Parade* (1930), and *Sherlock Holmes* (1932). Reginald Owen, who played Dr. Watson in the latter film, would portray Holmes the following year in *A Study in Scarlet*.

---

### 🎬 Basil Rathbone Era (1939–1946)
A series of fourteen films based on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories was released between 1939 and 1946; the British actors Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce played Holmes and Dr. John Watson, respectively. Basil Rathbone holds the record for portraying Sherlock Holmes in the most feature-length films, starring in 14 movies from 1939 to 1946.

| Year | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1939 | *The Hound of the Baskervilles* |
| 1939 | *The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* |
| 1942 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror* |
| 1942 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon* |
| 1943 | *Sherlock Holmes in Washington* |
| 1943 | *Sherlock Holmes Faces Death* |
| 1944 | *The Spider Woman* |
| 1944 | *The Scarlet Claw* |
| 1944 | *The Pearl of Death* |
| 1945 | *The House of Fear* |
| 1945 | *The Woman in Green* |
| 1945 | *Pursuit to Algiers* |
| 1946 | *Terror by Night* |
| 1946 | *Dressed to Kill* |

The Fox films had large budgets, high production values, and were set in the Victorian era, while Universal produced them as B pictures with lower budgets and updated the settings to the then-present time of the Second World War, with Holmes fighting the Nazis.

---

### 🎭 Mid-Century Films (1958–1988)

| Year | Title | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1959 | *The Hound of the Baskervilles* | Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee |
| 1970 | *The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes* | Robert Stephens |
| 1975 | *The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother* | Gene Wilder |
| 1976 | *The Seven-Per-Cent Solution* | Nicol Williamson, Robert Duvall |
| 1985 | *Young Sherlock Holmes* | Nicholas Rowe |
| 1986 | *The Great Mouse Detective* (animated) | Basil the Great Mouse Detective |
| 1988 | *Without a Clue* | Michael Caine, Ben Kingsley |

There have been origin stories like *Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985), a Disneyfication in *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986), and a case of mistaken identity in *Without a Clue* (1988).

---

### 📺 TV Movies / Later Films (1991–2004)

| Year | Title | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1991 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady* | Christopher Lee |
| 1991 | *Incident at Victoria Falls* | Christopher Lee |
| 1991 | *The Crucifer of Blood* | Charlton Heston |
| 2002 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking* | Rupert Everett |
| 2002 | *Case of Evil* | James D'Arcy |

The 1991–92 series *Sherlock Holmes the Golden Years* consisted of two TV films, in which Sherlock Holmes (played by Christopher Lee) and Dr. Watson (played by Patrick Macnee) are older adults who continue investigating cases. The two films were *Incident at Victoria Falls* and *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady*.

---

### 🔥 Modern Era (2009–Present)

| Year | Title | Stars | Director |
|------|-------|-------|----------|
| 2009 | *Sherlock Holmes* | Robert Downey Jr., Jude Law | Guy Ritchie |
| 2011 | *Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows* | Robert Downey Jr., Jude Law | Guy Ritchie |
| 2015 | *Mr. Holmes* | Ian McKellen | Bill Condon |
| 2020 | *Enola Holmes* | Millie Bobby Brown, Henry Cavill | Harry Bradbeer |
| 2022 | *Enola Holmes 2* | Millie Bobby Brown, Henry Cavill | Harry Bradbeer |

*Mr. Holmes* (2015) features an aged, retired Sherlock Holmes dealing with dementia as he tries to remember his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him, directed by Bill Condon and starring Ian McKellen.

Robert Downey Jr. won a Golden Globe for his role as a dishevelled bohemian Holmes, who is handy with fists and faculties alike.

---

### 📺 Notable TV Series
- **Sherlock** (2010–2017) — Benedict Cumberbatch, Martin Freeman
- **Elementary** (2012–2019) — Jonny Lee Miller, Lucy Liu
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** (1984–1994) — Jeremy Brett

Ill health dogged Jeremy Brett in the later episodes, which tended to draw on lesser-known tales. Nevertheless, for many, Brett will always be the definitive Sherlock Holmes.
